title: The Betrayal of Black Xuanwu
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji receives Su Qingyao's distress signal, and learns the traitor's identity—he is Chen Nian's trusted subordinate

text.content: A crescent moon hangs like a hook over the withered pines of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji sits cross-legged on a stone platform, clutching the torn page of the Tianji Record, his brow furrowed. The blurred name on the axis of fate still flickers before his eyes—it reads 'Chen Nian,' yet half its outline seems deliberately erased. He has divined seven times consecutively, each time the same, as if an invisible barrier separates him from his sister's fate. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembles within the pages, seeming to want to speak, yet forcibly restraining itself. This anomaly deepens Chen Ji's unease, but he must temporarily suppress his anxiety, for the current situation leaves no room for distraction.

Just then, the communication jade token in his arms suddenly grows scalding hot. Chen Ji's brow arches as he presses it to his brow center—three urgent messages flood his mind in succession. The first, from a Tianqing Sect secret agent, reads: 'Hai hour third quarter, Southern Branch attacked, casualties over half'; the second, from the Northern Wasteland outpost, merely four characters: 'Total collapse, return quickly'; the third is Su Qingyao's personal note, her handwriting unusually chaotic: 'Scheme leaked, traitor lurking, return quickly.' Chen Ji's eyes snap open, his knuckles cracking the jade token. The secret network he painstakingly built over three years at Tianqing Sect—wiped out in a single night?

dialogue.content: 'Three years of effort, destroyed in one night.' Mo Xiansheng's voice drifts from the depths of the pages, carrying an inexplicable tone, 'Do you want to know who leaked the information?' Chen Ji does not answer, merely tucking the jade token into his robe and slowly rising. His face betrays no anger whatsoever; even the corner of his lips carries a faint smile. Yet that smile, in Mo Xiansheng's eyes, is more chilling than rage. 'No need to say.' Chen Ji clasps his hands behind his back, gazing at the night sky, his voice terrifyingly calm, 'The Tianji Record's divination of events within three hours costs only five Heavenly Fate points—if someone wants to see my cards, I'll let them see enough.'

text.content: The pages of the Tianji Record flutter without wind, golden text swimming before Chen Ji's eyes like serpents. He sees the flames at the Southern Branch, the secret agents at the Northern Wasteland outpost fallen in blood, and most shockingly, a figure he never expected—Elder Zhou, one of the Four Elders of Black Xuanwu, handing a secret letter to an envoy of Cang Yutian. And the wax seal on that letter bears the family insignia that Chen Ji personally gave to his sister Chen Nian. The vision ends abruptly, as if some force deliberately obscures what follows. Chen Ji's pupils contract sharply, his fingertips trembling involuntarily.

Zhou Jingyuan. Chen Ji remembers this name clearly—when he first entered Tianqing Sect three years ago, Elder Zhou was the first to support him, and was also the figure Chen Nian personally wrote 'trustworthy' beside before her disappearance. Chen Ji had arranged his sister's trusted aide to secretly assist Zhou Jingyuan, intending multiple layers of security—yet today it becomes the blade that invites the wolf into the house. He takes a deep breath, tucking the Tianji Record into his sleeve, killing intent crystallizing in his eyes like tangible substance. The price of the Tianji Record is always worth it—he has seen the traitor, glimpsed the tip of the iceberg of Cang Yutian's scheme. This time, he will let everyone know what happens when they provoke Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji, you're finally responding!' Su Qingyao's voice comes through the communication talisman, carrying barely contained urgency, 'Night Qing and I have already arrived at the Southern Branch, but the enemy came too fast—we only managed to rescue seventeen people. As for the North... Night Qing's outpost also suffered heavy losses, and we're currently retreating to Cloud Hidden Villa, but Cang Yutian's people seem to have known this route all along—they've sent three Golden Core stage experts to encircle us. Night Qing and I can barely hold them off.' The clash of weapons echoes from the communication, Su Qingyao's voice dropping sharply, 'If you don't come back now, we won't survive the night!'

text.content: Chen Ji's foot halts mid-step. He can hear Night Qing's cold snort from the other end, the booming explosions of magical artifacts, and more clearly, Su Qingyao's ragged breathing as she grits her teeth. Protective—though this is the instinct Chen Ji least wants to admit, it is etched into his bones. The three-year scheme can be rebuilt from scratch, the intelligence network can be rewoven, but if Su Qingyao and Night Qing come to harm, that is a loss he cannot bear. He closes his eyes, calculations racing through his mind: he is currently at Tianqing Sect, Cloud Hidden Villa is about two hours' walk away; if he flies by sword, it can be shortened to half an hour, but it will certainly alert sect observers, and the old sect leader Ling Yuan will know.

choice.prompt: Cloud Hidden Villa hangs by a thread, Su Qingyao and Night Qing desperately await reinforcements—Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Fly by sword, arrive at Cloud Hidden Villa in half an hour. Though it will expose his whereabouts, it provides the fastest rescue for Su Qingyao and Night Qing.
choices.visible_reward: Rescue Su Qingyao and Night Qing in time, stabilize the situation
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan surely has a backup plan

text.content: Sword light tears through the void, Chen Ji's form becoming a streak of brilliance. The sect's prohibitions explode in ripples around him yet cannot stop this resolute charge. A cold snort comes from Ling Yuan's cave direction—Chen Ji ignores it completely. This is not the time for scheming; saving lives comes first. Amid the howling wind, he draws the torn page from the Tianji Record, forcing a drop of refined blood from his fingertip, forcibly glimpsing the current scene at Cloud Hidden Villa. In the blood-red haze, he sees Su Qingyao fighting two opponents alone, Night Qing's demonic energy on the verge of exhaustion, and most chillingly, the Golden Core expert encircling them—Cang Yutian's Vice Sect Master, Li Qingming!

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji, where do you think you're going?' Ling Yuan's aged voice rings out behind him, the pressure like a mountain collapsing. Chen Ji doesn't even turn his head: 'Disciple has urgent business outside the sect, please forgive me, Sect Master.' Ling Yuan's阴恻恻 laughter drifts over: 'Urgent business? Hmph, let me see what could be more important than sect rules. Sealing the mountain formation—nobody leaves the sect!' Chen Ji's eyes narrow, his fingertip already crushing a talisman in his sleeve—the secret move he laid on the mortal world, now is the time to activate it.

choices.description: Temporarily delay rescue, let the enemy think Chen Ji is unaware, secretly activate the already-prepared countermeasure to turn the tables.
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao and Night Qing's situation grows more dangerous
choices.visible_reward: Uncover all insiders at once, turn defeat into victory

text.content: Chen Ji settles back into meditation, his expression eerily calm. The communication talisman vibrates again, Su Qingyao's voice trembling with disbelief: 'Chen Ji, you... did you hear? We're surrounded! Li Qingming personally intervened, Night Qing is already wounded—are you coming or not?' Chen Ji offers no response, merely placing the communication talisman on his knee, letting the cries from the other end gradually fade into despairful silence. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighs: 'Are you giving up on them?' Chen Ji raises his eyes, cold light flashing: 'Give up? I'm merely waiting for a moment—for Cang Yutian's people to think victory is assured, for Zhou Jingyuan to think the mission is accomplished, for every specter and demon to show itself.'

dialogue.content: 'You still have a trump card?' Mo Xiansheng's voice carries a hint of curiosity. Chen Ji draws a pitch-black token from his robes, carved with the characters 'Xuanwu': 'The secret agent I planted in Black Xuanwu three years ago was meant as the final guarantee for Chen Nian. Now that Zhou Jingyuan has betrayed, it's perfect for purging the ranks.' He flicks the token with a finger, and it transforms into streaming light vanishing into the horizon. Meanwhile, at Cloud Hidden Villa's periphery, a concealed black-armored squad silently appears—those are the death warriors Chen Ji secretly raised while walking the world under his 'wastrel' persona. Su Qingyao, wait a moment longer—before the storm breaks, someone must endure first.

choices.text: Cut off the limb to save the body
choices.description: Abandon some bases in the mortal realm, preserve core strength, and shift the focus of the layout back to the sect.
choices.visible_cost: Years of hard work destroyed in an instant
choices.visible_reward: Preserve core personnel, removing the fuel to let the enemy扑空

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and tapped lightly on the communication talisman several times—that was the highest-level withdrawal order. Moments later, confirmation messages came from various bases: the South An Branch activated its self-destruct formation, core hidden agents had evacuated through secret passages; the North Wilderness base destroyed all intelligence archives, and remaining personnel transferred to backup positions. He even ordered the detonation of a false intelligence repository that Cang Yutian had long coveted, making the enemy believe they had snatched a treasure, when in truth it was merely a pile of waste paper Chen Ji had prepared long ago. 'Three years of planning,一夜归零.' Chen Ji murmured, his tone betraying neither joy nor anger. 'Zhou Jingyuan, you're very well.'

dialogue.content: The communication talisman lit up again. This time Su Qingyao's voice was much calmer, yet carried suppressed fury: 'Chen Ji, your orders received. The pursuers around Cloud Hidden Manor suddenly withdrew half their forces, as if receiving some command—could Cang Yutian's main force be chasing something else? Ye Qing and I are temporarily safe.' She paused, her voice turning cold: 'Also, Chen Nian's confidant... we caught someone who claims to be sent by your sister to contact Zhou Jingyuan. On him, he carried a token written personally by Chen Nian three years ago.' Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, his pupils trembling.

text.content: Chen Ji's mind exploded into a void. When Chen Nian disappeared three years ago, the clues left behind were scarce—he had exhausted every effort to trace only the faint traces of the Holy Sect. Now a 'sister's confidant' had suddenly appeared, carrying a handwritten token? His rationality screamed warnings—this was too convenient, too much like a trap specifically set for him. But the wound in his heart that had never healed throbbed with隐隐作痛, preventing him from sitting idle. Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long while before speaking: 'This matter does have its oddities. But if this truly is Chen Nian's person... what do you plan to do?' Chen Ji did not answer, but instead opened the Tianji Record again, this time directly burning ten points of Heavenly Fate Value, projecting his vision toward that 'confidant's' face.

Blurred. Still blurred! Chen Nian's figure in the Tianji Record remained shrouded in a layer of mist, making everything related to her hazy and unclear. But just as the image was about to fade, Chen Ji saw the 'confidant's' eyes—eyes he knew too well, phoenix eyes identical to Chen Nian's, with slightly upturned corners carrying the unique arc of Chen family bloodline. His heart felt like it was being viciously gripped, his breath stopping for a moment. Three years—this was the first clue related to his sister, real or not, he had to personally verify. 'Mo Xiansheng.' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse. 'If this is a trap, would you stop me?'

dialogue.content: 'What have I ever stopped you from doing?' Mo Xiansheng's tone carried a hint of helplessness. 'From the moment the Tianji Record chose you, your fate no longer belongs to yourself.' The remnant soul sighed faintly. 'But there is one thing I can tell you—it's fact that Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect, and it's also fact that the Holy Sect secretly colludes with Cang Yutian. If this 'confidant' truly is Chen Nian's person, his appearance here itself is a game within a game.' Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly lowered. 'The question is, who is the one setting the board? Does Cang Yutian want to lure you into a trap, or... does someone else want to use your hand to eliminate Cang Yutian?' Chen Ji fell silent. He thought of Old Sect Master Ling Yuan, of the 'Ancient Will' that had always been watching him from the shadows, and most importantly, of that vague name on the axis of fate.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji must decide how to handle this clue that may be a trap—whether to personally go verify, or send someone else.

choices.description: Whether it's a trap or not, this is the only clue related to Chen Nian in three years. Chen Ji must see it with his own eyes.
choices.visible_cost: Might fall right into the enemy's scheme
choices.visible_reward: Opportunity to see clues about his sister, possibly even rescue relevant personnel
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may have a killing move specifically targeting Chen Ji

text.content: Chen Ji rose and straightened his robe. His expression was unexpectedly calm, as if that momentary loss of composure had never happened. 'Su Qingyao, keep that person under close watch for me.' He said into the communication talisman. 'I'll be there in half an hour.' From the other end came Su Qingyao's complex gaze—she knew Chen Ji too well, understanding what that calm in his eyes meant. People at the peak of fury are often the most composed. 'Ye Qing.' Chen Ji spoke again. 'Since Cang Yutian's pursuers withdrew half their forces, it means their target isn't just the bases—don't let anyone approach that 'confidant'. Before I arrive, a living person is more useful than a dead one.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's voice came through the communication, carrying a playful note: 'Chen Ji, are you giving orders to this Saint?' Chen Ji replied calmly: 'You can choose not to listen. But don't forget, who was it that told you the Holy Sect's upper echelon planned to use you as a sacrifice?' The communication went silent for a moment. Ye Qing snorted coldly: 'Fine, I know my limits. But Chen Ji, you'd better be prepared—this person, when brought back, was severely injured, and has been murmuring a name repeatedly.' Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat: 'What name?' 'Chen Nian.' Ye Qing's voice was uncharacteristically serious. 'He said... he said the young miss is still alive, imprisoned in a place called the 'Heavenly Fate Altar'.'

choices.description: Don't risk personal danger—send Su Qingyao or Ye Qing to interrogate and probe first, confirm the intelligence's authenticity before making a decision.
choices.risk_hint: If the intelligence is true, may miss the chance to rescue his sister

text.content: Chen Ji contemplated briefly and spoke into the communication talisman: 'Don't bring that person to me yet. Su Qingyao, you and Ye Qing interrogate together. Remember one thing—if this person truly is Chen Nian's, he must know some secret only Chen family bloodline would know. Ask him if Chen Nian has a birthmark below her left shoulder blade—that's something I witnessed with my own eyes as a child.' From the other end came Su Qingyao's acknowledgment. Chen Ji added: 'Also, ask him what Chen Nian last gave him before she disappeared—that's a jade pendant passed down through Chen generations, carved with the character 'Ji'.' These were secrets known only to Chen Ji himself and Chen Nian.

dialogue.content: Moments later, Su Qingyao's reply came, her voice carrying suppressed excitement: 'Chen Ji, he got it right. The birthmark's location was exact, and he also produced the jade pendant for us to see—it truly is a Chen family token. But...' Su Qingyao's tone suddenly turned grave. 'After saying all this, he suddenly coughed up blood and said he has something to tell only you, alone. He also said something strange—'Young master, this old servant failed the young miss, it was this old servant who harmed her.' Chen Ji, this person... he seems connected to the young miss's disappearance.' From the other end came some commotion. Ye Qing's voice cut in: 'Hey, his condition isn't good. It seems someone placed a restriction curse on him—if he speaks forcibly, the restriction will trigger and kill him!'

choices.description: Since the enemy wanted to use Chen Nian's clue to draw him into their trap, Chen Ji turned the tables and instead used this pawn to spread false intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: Might provoke the mastermind behind the scenes
choices.visible_reward: Might lure out the real culprit
choices.risk_hint: The truth might be concealed even longer

text.content: A cold light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes: "Since they want to use news of Chen Nian to bait me, I'll let them bait away." He commanded through the communication talisman, "Su Qingyao, watch that person carefully, but don't let him know I'm monitoring. Have Ye Qing use the 'Demonic Path Mist' to obscure his perception, then you disguise yourself as his messenger and spread the word—say that Chen Ji, upon learning news of his sister, has lost emotional control and secretly rushed to the Heavenly Fate Altar to rescue her." After a moment of silence on the other end of the communication, Su Qingyao's voice carried a hint of astonishment: "You're using yourself as bait?"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing laughed lightly: "Chen Ji, are you planning to take down both Cang Yutian and the Holy Sect in one fell swoop? Clever scheme, this saintess approves. However..." Her tone suddenly turned serious, "I've only heard rumors about this 'Heavenly Fate Altar.' They say it was used in ancient times to imprison the Heavenly Dao's will. Those who enter have their souls stripped away piece by piece until they become empty shells. Are you sure you want to spread such a message?" Chen Ji gave no answer. He closed his eyes, rapidly deducing various possibilities in his mind—Ling Yuan's reaction, Cang Yutian's layout, the Holy Sect's true purpose, and that ever-present mysterious 'Eye of Heavenly Dao.' Whoever was orchestrating this, he would not wait to be slaughtered. This time, he would let everyone know what the true fangs of thetrash陈机 looked like.

text.content: Just then, the formation outside the cave was triggered. Chen Ji frowned, his divine sense probing outward—the visitor was actually Ling Yuan's personal attendant, holding a dazzling token in his hands. "Senior Brother Chen, the Sect Master requests your presence." The attendant's tone was respectful, but his gaze carried unmistakable scrutiny. Chen Ji sneered in his heart, his expression unchanged: "The Sect Master summoned me so late at night, I wonder what important matter requires attention?" The attendant bowed: "The Sect Master says that lately the Black Xuanwu has encountered some changes, and he'd like Senior Brother Chen to come discuss the matter." Chen Ji instantly understood—Ling Yuan was testing him, or rather, warning him. His bold departure from the sect today had already alarmed this old fox, and this summons was clearly meant to trap him within the sect.

"Very well." Chen Ji agreed without hesitation. He had no choice—before truly tearing things apart, Ling Yuan was still the Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, and his public identity was still "trash杂役弟子". If he openly disobeyed now, it would give Ling Yuan a reason to deal with him. He followed the attendant through layers of palaces and halls, arriving at the "Tai Xu Hall" where Ling Yuan conducted his daily affairs. The hall doors slowly opened, and a heavyimposing swept over him. Ling Yuan sat upright at the main seat, his murky old eyes half-open and half-closed, revealing nothing of his emotions. "Chen Ji." The aged voice echoed through the great hall, "You left the sect hastily today, where were you going?" Chen Ji bowed respectfully, his posture flawless in its deference: "Reporting to the Sect Master, the disciple received news that several mortal world business ventures had some issues. I intended to handle them quickly, not daring to disturb the Sect Master's cultivation."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan slowly opened his eyes, a flash of sharpness appearing in his murky gaze: "Oh? Mortal world business ventures? How could I recall that you are merely a servant disciple, where would you have business ventures in the mortal world?" Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression showed only panic: "The Sect Master is perceptive, those ventures are all managed by the disciple on behalf of the sect, and the accounts have always been reviewed by Elder Zhou. It's just that recently I heard Elder Zhou seems to have... found another path, and the disciple fears those ventures might fall into outsiders' hands. That's why I was so anxious." Ling Yuan's gaze lingered on his face for a long while, then suddenly smiled: "You already know that Zhou Jingyuan betrayed Tianqing Sect and joined Cang Yutian?" Chen Ji raised his head, and a perfectly timed flicker of surprise appeared in his eyes: "Elder Zhou betrayed? The disciple... the disciple truly didn't know, may the Sect Master enlighten me!"

text.content: Ling Yuan waved his hand, signaling him not to be overly polite: "Very well, since you didn't know, go rest." Chen Ji bowed and took his leave, but in the instant he turned, he caught the fleeting寒芒 in Ling Yuan's eyes. He knew he was being watched, but this wasn't the time to settle accounts. Walking out of Tai Xu Hall, the night wind brushed his face, and Chen Ji took a deep breath. The communication talisman vibrated again—Su Qingyao's message: "The interrogation made progress. That person said one thing before dying—'The key to the Heavenly Fate Altar is on his own person.' Chen Ji, the 'he' he mentioned, is you." Chen Ji's footsteps suddenly stopped. The key to the Heavenly Fate Altar... on himself? He unconsciously touched the Tianji Record fragment in his arms, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly trembled violently.

dialogue.content: "So that's how it is... so that's how it is!" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried irrepressible shock, "Chen Ji, do you know where the Tianji Record originally came from?" Chen Ji frowned: "Didn't you say it was a supreme treasure left by ancient prophets?" Mo Xiansheng laughed, but the laughter was full of bitterness: "Prophets? Hmph, that was merely a lie fabricated by the Heavenly Dao's will! The true origin of the Tianji Record is that three thousand years ago, the first generation 'Heavenly Fate Altar Grave Keeper' forged it with his life's essence—it can both open and seal the altar. And this fragment on your body is only part of the key. The true key... is a jade pendant inscribed with the character '机'!" Chen Ji was thunderstruck. The Chen family heirloom jade pendant—the jade pendant Chen Nian left him—he always thought it was merely an ordinary token!

text.content: Chen Ji's heart raced. When Chen Nian disappeared three years ago, she left him that jade pendant, saying it was "a Chen family heirloom that would serve its purpose in the future." He always thought it was merely his sister's kind gesture, never giving it deeper thought. Now Mo Xiansheng's words were like a sudden enlightenment, making him instantly understand many things—Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect, not because she knew some secret, but because she knew where the jade pendant was! She was protecting him, trading her freedom for the safety of this key. Chen Ji's eyes reddened slightly, his knuckles white from clenching. He took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his emotions. Now was not the time for grief—his sister might still be saved, and he had to race against time.

The communication talisman lit up again, this time transmitting not text but an urgent voice message. Su Qingyao's voice carried irrepressible panic: "Chen Ji! Cang Yutian's people are here, faster than we anticipated! Li Qingming personally led the team, along with three elders at the Nascent Soul stage—we can't hold them! Ye Qing's demonic energy is already depleted, and I'm injured too. That 'confidant' is already dead, and before dying he used blood to write a character on the ground—'机'. Chen Ji, why haven't you arrived yet?" The voice cut off abruptly, replaced by harsh static. Chen Ji gripped the communication talisman in his palm, his knuckles white. He looked toward Yun Yin Manor, his killing intent再也掩饰不住.

"Li Qingming..." Chen Ji uttered this name slowly, his voice cold enough to freeze. He was the Vice Sect Master of Cang Yutian, with cultivation at the late Nascent Soul stage—top-tier even in the entire cultivation world. For such a figure to personally lead an ambush against several juniors at the Golden Core stage was truly overkill. But he didn't care. Su Qingyao had been giving her all to stabilize his rear; Ye Qing, that proud Demon Path Saintess, was probably using her last trace of demonic energy to protect their last stronghold. He hesitated no longer, his sword light flashing as he transformed into a shooting star and soared into the sky. A cold snort came from the direction of Ling Yuan's cave, but Chen Ji turned a deaf ear—tonight, whoever dared to stop him would die.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji flew his sword at full speed toward Yun Yin Manor, and on the way he had to make the final decision—whether to fight head-on or have another trick up his sleeve?

choices.description: Descend upon Yun Yin Manor with the strongest posture, directly clash with Li Qingming, buying precious recovery time for Su Qingyao and Ye Qing.
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate the enemy, boost allies' morale
choices.risk_hint: If entangled, may fall into a bitter battle

text.content: Sword light like the Milky Way cascading down, tearing through the night sky. Chen Ji was mid-air, his long sword already transformed into ten thousand sword shadows, bombarding toward Yun Yin Manor in one concentrated wave. Li Qingming was pursuing Su Qingyao and Ye Qing when caught off guard, forced to retreat several zhang by this sudden strike. He looked up at the newcomer, his pupils contracting sharply: "Chen Ji?! Weren't you supposed to be..." Before he could finish, Chen Ji's second sword strike arrived. This strike had no flashy moves, only pure killing intent—he burned a full ten points of Heavenly Fate, infusing the power of the Tianji Record into his sword. One strike, and the spiritual energy within a hundred zhang was completely drained. Li Qingming's expression finally changed: "You've gone mad! For two women, you dare burn your Heavenly Fate value!"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao gazed at the figure in mid-air, her eyes slightly reddened. This Chen Ji at this moment was no longer thetrash杂役弟子 who was bullied at will, but a true man who stood tall between heaven and earth. Ye Qing leaned against the broken wall, a complex smile curving her lips: "Chen Ji, you're late. This saintess thought you really didn't care whether we lived or died." Chen Ji didn't turn around, but his voice clearly reached both their ears: "I said I would protect you both." He raised his sword toward Li Qingming, killing intent in his eyes like tangible substance, "Vice Sect Master Li, you besieged my allies and slaughtered my subordinates—this account should be settled today." Li Qingming coldly laughed: "Just with you?" Chen Ji smiled, the smile full of contempt: "Foundation Building stage? Are you sure?"

choices.description: Avoid direct conflict with Li Qingming, bypass and strike Cang Yutian's rear army, disrupting the enemy's formation.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to rescue Su Qingyao immediately
choices.visible_reward: Disintegrate enemy morale and inflict greater casualties
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao and Ye Qing may not be able to hold on

text.content: Chen Ji's figure flickered, not charging toward Li Qingming, but transforming into a stream of light and darting toward the rear. Li Qingming was stunned for a moment, then his face changed dramatically: "He wants to destroy the supplies! Stop him!" Cang Yutian's supply convoy was the lifeblood of the entire army's logistics. Once destroyed, the front-line soldiers would be left without provisions or ammunition. Chen Ji sneered: "Besiege Wei to rescue Zhao? Vice Sect Master Li, you seem to have forgotten—I am the Master of the Tianji Pavilion, and what I'm best at has never been direct combat." Dozens of talismans flew from his sleeve, each one meticulously drawn by him over three years—explosive talismans capable of destroying a small mountain.

dialogue.content: The talismans swarmed toward the supply convoy like locusts. Simultaneously, Chen Ji activated the Tianji Record, forcibly deducing the enemy positions around the convoy—three Golden Core stage cultivators, twelve Foundation Building stage cultivators, with the weak point in the protective formation on the right side of the upper wind. His sword light flashed, precisely passing through the thinnest point of defense, stabbing into a wagon transporting spirit pills. A deafening explosion erupted, flames shooting into the sky, as Cang Yutian's spirit pill reserves turned to ashes scattered across the heavens. Li Qingming's eyes blazed with fury: "Chen Ji! I will make you beg for death!" Chen Ji stood at the edge of the inferno, turned to glance at him, his smile more piercing than the flames: "Vice Sect Master Li, is the fire beautiful? Take your time putting it out. I'll be taking my leave first."

choices.description: Activate the final trump card of the mortal realm layout—that Black Armor Death Warrior squad, letting them harass the enemy in the shadows.
choices.visible_reward: The enemy falls into chaos, allowing Su Qingyao and Ye Qing to escape
choices.risk_hint: The death warriors' casualties will be irreplaceable

text.content: Chen Ji took out a pitch-black token from his chest. Upon it was carved the pattern of a black eagle with spread wings. He flicked it with his thumb, shattering the token. An invisible wave spread in all directions. The next moment, emerging from the darkness surrounding Cloud Hidden Villa, hundreds of shadow figures darted out like ghosts. Each wore identical black armor, held standardized magical swords, and moved in perfect unison, as if one person. This was the dark chess piece Chen Ji had painstakingly cultivated over three years—the Black Eagle Death Warrior Battalion. They belonged to no sect, answering only to Chen Ji. Li Qingming's pupils constricted: "Black Eagle Death Warriors?! A mere servant disciple like you actually maintains such private troops!"

dialogue.content: The death warriors spoke not a word, like hungry wolves pouncing into a flock of sheep, precisely cutting through Cang Yutian's formation. Their cultivation levels were not high—the strongest commander was merely at the early Golden Core stage—but their coordination was seamless. Every three formed a team, specifically targeting the weakest cultivators among the enemy ranks. For a time, Cang Yutian's formation fell into chaos. The three Nascent Soul stage elders originally encircling Su Qingyao had to split two of their number to stabilize the situation. Ye Qing seized the opportunity to break free, standing back-to-back with Su Qingyao. Watching the sky filled with cries of battle, Ye Qing murmured: "Chen Ji, how many more trump cards do you have hidden?" Chen Ji's voice came through the communication talisman, still calm: "Not many. But enough."

text.content: On the Cloud Hidden Villa battlefield, battle cries shook the heavens. Chen Ji hovered on his sword in the midair, overlooking the chaos below. Though his Black Eagle Death Warriors were few in number, each was fearless, literally tearing through Cang Yutian's encirclement with flesh and blood. Su Qingyao and Ye Qing had broken free, retreating toward his position. Li Qingming's furious voice echoed through the night sky: "Chen Ji! Do you think a few death warriors can stop me? Dream on!" He fully activated the Nascent Soul stage's oppressive aura, transforming into a black lightning bolt, lunging directly at Chen Ji.

Chen Ji did not dodge or evade, allowing that streak of black light to charge toward him. The corner of his mouth lifted in a mocking curve: "Vice Sect Master Li, do you truly believe I would personally risk danger?" Before his words even finished, Li Qingming's form suddenly stiffened—he looked down at his chest, where a pitch-black short blade had somehow pierced through. The wielder was an unremarkable middle-aged man, wearing ordinary disciple robes of Cang Yutian, now revealing a smile most familiar to Chen Ji. "Cang Yutian's hidden agent, codename 'Viper,' pays respects to Master Chen." Li Qingming's eyes widened. Until his final breath, he dared not believe he had died by the hand of his own man. He wanted to speak, but only managed to spurt a mouthful of black blood before his breath ceased forever.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing witnessed this scene, couldn't help but inhale sharply: "Chen Ji, you madman... How many spies did you embed inside Cang Yutian?" Chen Ji landed slowly, stepping through the blood-soaked ground toward Li Qingming's corpse. His face held no victory's joy, only an indefinable weariness. "Not many." He bent down, searching Li Qingming's chest and extracting a token. "Just enough." Su Qingyao ran over, her face covered in blood and grime, but her eyes blazing remarkably bright: "Chen Ji, we won!" Chen Ji shook his head: "This is merely the beginning. Li Qingming is dead, but Cang Yutian won't let this rest. And Zhou Jingyuan... His debt remains unsettled." He raised his head, gazing toward Tianqing Sect, cold light flickering in his eyes. "And that old fox Ling Yuan. He must already know about tonight's events."

text.content: The battlefield gradually quieted. Cang Yutian's broken remnants retreated like a tide. The Black Eagle Death Warriors tallied their casualties: thirty-seven killed, twenty-one seriously wounded, over two hundred enemies slain, and four Golden Core stage experts eliminated. This was a glorious victory, yet Chen Ji could not feel happy. He crouched down, looking at the hidden agent codenamed "Viper," and softly said: "Three years. You hid deep enough." The man grinned, revealing a mouthful of yellow teeth: "Master Chen flatters me. Had it not been for your lifesaving grace back then, I would never have been able to serve you unto death today." Chen Ji patted his shoulder: "Hard work. After tonight, the rest of yours and your family's lives, I Chen Ji will take care of." Viper chuckled, stepped backward, and vanished into the night as a shadow.

Su Qingyao walked over, gazing at Chen Ji's profile, words unspoken. Chen Ji didn't look at her, merely gazing at the clouds gradually dispersing in the night sky, and softly said: "If you have something to ask, just ask." Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, then finally spoke: "Just now... Did you already calculate that Li Qingming would personally make a move?" Chen Ji nodded: "I deduced it using the Tianji Record. Tonight, Cang Yutian's true target wasn't me—it was that 'key to the Heavenly Fate Altar' in Zhou Jingyuan's words. Li Qingming thought he was encircling my allies, but in reality, he was doing someone else's bidding." Ye Qing coldly snorted: "Then his death was not undeserved." Chen Ji shook his head: "He was merely a chess piece. The one truly playing the game still hides behind the scenes." He turned his head, his gaze profound. "Before Chen Nian's confidant died, he said 'the key is on Chen Ji'—this phrase has spread. Cang Yutian, the Holy Sect, even Ling Yuan... They will all target me."

Su Qingyao's expression changed: "Then why were you still so ostentatious just now? You knew more people would set their sights on you!" Chen Ji smiled, his expression carrying a hint of helplessness: "I had no choice. Li Qingming came right to my doorstep to bully me. If I still hid and held back, wouldn't that make others think Chen Ji is easy to bully?" He paused, his tone suddenly serious. "Moreover, this battle tonight showed everyone—though I Chen Ji am merely atrash杂役 at Foundation Building stage, my people are not to be messed with!" Ye Qing looked at him, suddenly softly said: "You... are really overly protective of your own." Chen Ji did not deny, merely turning to gaze toward Tianqing Sect, his voice low: "Tonight's events aren't over. With Ling Yuan, the showdown may need to happen sooner."

Meanwhile, at Tianqing Sect, within the Taixu Hall. Ling Yuan sat upright at the main seat, having listened to the attendant's report, his turbid old eyes slightly narrowed. "Li Qingming is dead?" His voice revealed neither joy nor anger. "That Chen Ji boy actually has such ability." The attendant bowed: "According to reports, it was Chen Ji's hidden agent within Cang Yutian who made the move. That agent had been hiding for at least three years. Li Qingming never suspected a thing." Ling Yuan was silent for a long while, then suddenly smiled: "A fine example of hiding one's strength while feigning weakness. This old man underestimated him." His smile gradually turned cold. "Issue the order—starting tomorrow, strengthen surveillance on Chen Ji. This old man wants to see how long he can keep hiding." Outside the hall, night wind howled, making the candlelight sway unsteadily. Ling Yuan gazed toward the window, a meaningful gleam flickering in his eyes: "The key to the Heavenly Fate Altar... So it was always under this old man's nose. Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, how many secrets do you still have?"

At Cloud Hidden Villa, Chen Ji stood atop the ruins, the Chen Family jade pendant he had retrieved from Chen Nian's confidant clutched in his hand. The front of the jade pendant bore a simple "Ji" character, while the back displayed a line of tiny characters—"Heavenly Fate Resides Within Me." He examined it repeatedly for a long time, then softly asked: "Mister Mo, what does this sentence mean?" Mister Mo's remnant soul was silent for a long time before slowly speaking: "This is the maxim of the successive Grave Keepers. The Heavenly Fate Altar seals a fragment of the Heavenly Dao's will, and the Grave Keeper's mission is to ensure this fragment can never break free from its seal." His voice suddenly grew heavy. "Chen Ji, do you know why the Tianji Record chose you?" Chen Ji did not answer, merely waiting quietly for what would follow.

dialogue.content: "Because you carry the Chen bloodline." Mister Mo's voice carried a trace of emotion. "Three thousand years ago, the first Grave Keeper was an ancestor of the Chen family. He merged his lifetime of cultivation into the jade pendant, becoming part of the seal. And the Tianji Record is a legacy item left by each generation of Grave Keepers—its criterion for selecting an inheritor is but one: bloodline." Chen Ji gripped the jade pendant tightly, his knuckles white. "So... Chen Nian's disappearance is also because of this?" Mister Mo sighed: "Though Chen Nian is a woman, she is the person with the purest bloodline of the current Chen generation. The Holy Sect captured her to use her bloodline to break the seal." Chen Ji's breathing quickened: "Then my father, my mother? They are also Chen family members—where are they now?" Mister Mo was silent for a long while before finally uttering words that made Chen Ji feel as though he had fallen into an icy abyss: "Your parents... three years ago, to rescue Chen Nian, already died at the hands of the Holy Sect."

text.content: Chen Ji's body trembled violently. Three years ago... three years ago was precisely the time Chen Nian disappeared, also the time he began his layout in the mortal realm. During that period, he was busy establishing an intelligence network, with no time to attend to family affairs. Later, learning his parents had "traveled elsewhere," he never investigated deeply. But now he understood—they had died trying to rescue his sister. He closed his eyes, two clear tears falling silently. Su Qingyao and Ye Qing exchanged glances, both seeing worry in each other's eyes. They didn't know what Mister Mo had told Chen Ji, but merely observing Chen Ji's current state made it clear this was no small matter. Ye Qing remarkably refrained from mockery, merely standing quietly at the side, as if guarding something.

After a long while, Chen Ji opened his eyes. His eye sockets were still red, but his gaze had recovered its usual composure. "Mister Mo." His voice was hoarse. "Where is the Heavenly Fate Altar?" Mister Mo was silent for a moment: "You plan to rescue Chen Nian?" Chen Ji did not speak, but that silence itself was the answer. Mister Mo sighed heavily: "Very well, what must come will come. The Heavenly Fate Altar lies deep within the Cangwu Mountain Range, north of Central Prefecture and south of the Northern Sea. That place is perpetually shrouded in mist, where ordinary people absolutely cannot enter." His voice suddenly turned solemn. "But Chen Ji, you must know—once you enter the altar's range, what you will face is not only people from the Holy Sect, but also... the Heavenly Dao's will itself." Chen Ji gripped the jade pendant tightly, a cold smile curling his lips: "The Heavenly Dao's will?" His eyes blazed with unprecedented fighting spirit. "Then let me see exactly what great ability it possesses."

Night wind howled, ruffling Chen Ji's robes. He tucked the jade pendant into his chest, turned to gaze at Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, his voice low yet firm: "Tonight's events—thank you both for your hard work." Su Qingyao shook her head: "Don't mention such things. Between us, what's the need for courtesy?" Ye Qing raised her brow: "This Holy Maiden is not doing this for you—it's to repay the favor you owed me." Chen Ji did not expose her pretense, merely nodding lightly. He raised his head, gazing toward Tianqing Sect, a flash of determination in his eyes. Ling Yuan, Zhou Jingyuan, Cang Yutian, the Holy Sect... and that so-called Heavenly Dao's will. Chen Ji had walked from atrash杂役 to where he was today, never relying on luck, but on meticulous strategies with no room for error. Now that the chessboard had been laid out, let everyone see—who truly is the Chess Player in this game.
